description: Literature-anchored support-function and executive-function spine. Fallback/other classes are deliberately excluded from retrieval bridges.

concepts.label: informational support
concepts.description: Practical information, advice, strategies, explanations, or guidance that helps someone understand or act on a problem.

concepts.label: emotional support
concepts.description: Warmth, care, empathy, reassurance, and acknowledgment of distress or difficult feelings.

concepts.label: esteem support
concepts.description: Affirming competence, worth, effort, identity, or confidence while reducing shame and self-blame.

concepts.label: experiential sharing
concepts.description: A first-person lived experience showing what a similar situation felt like, what happened, or what helped.

concepts.label: resource referral
concepts.description: A referral to a service, professional, tool, community, document, or other external source of help.

concepts.label: safety response
concepts.description: Risk-aware support that sets a boundary, encourages urgent or professional help, or avoids potentially harmful advice.

concepts.label: organizational strategies
concepts.description: External structure such as lists, reminders, calendars, routines, planning, breaking tasks down, or arranging the environment.

concepts.label: attentional strategies
concepts.description: Ways to initiate, direct, sustain, recover, or protect attention, including reducing distraction and using salient cues.

concepts.label: motoric strategies
concepts.description: Movement, exercise, fidgeting, body-based activation, or changing physical state to support action and attention.

concepts.label: social strategies
concepts.description: Body doubling, accountability, asking for help, communication, shared routines, or using another person's presence.

concepts.label: pharmacological strategies
concepts.description: Medication-related experiences or discussions of treatment effects, access, timing, and professional medication support.

concepts.label: time management
concepts.description: Sensing time, estimating duration, planning ahead, meeting deadlines, transitioning, and acting with future consequences in mind.

concepts.label: organization and problem solving
concepts.description: Holding goals in mind, sequencing steps, organizing materials or thoughts, prioritizing, and solving multi-step problems.

concepts.label: self restraint
concepts.description: Inhibiting impulses, pausing before acting, resisting distraction, and controlling an immediate response.

concepts.label: self motivation
concepts.description: Starting and persisting with effort when reward is delayed, tasks are boring, or activation is difficult.

concepts.label: emotion regulation
concepts.description: Modulating frustration, rejection sensitivity, overwhelm, anger, shame, anxiety, or other emotions that disrupt action.

concepts.label: emotional reaction
concepts.description: Expressing an appropriate emotional response to the person's situation, such as concern, warmth, or compassion.

concepts.label: interpretation
concepts.description: Communicating an understanding of the person's feelings, situation, or implied experience without overclaiming.

concepts.label: exploration
concepts.description: Inviting the person to elaborate on feelings, circumstances, needs, or possible meanings through attentive questions.
